title: psacalium amplum
intro: Psacalium amplum, commonly known as tree daisy, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is a shrub-like plant that grows in the mountainous regions of Mexico and is traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Psacalium amplum include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitussive properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
